build_channel_directory: build a channel directory from connected platform adapters and session data, returning the directory dict and writing it to disk
load_directory: load the cached channel directory from disk, returning the directory dict or an empty structure if unavailable
resolve_channel_name: resolve a human-friendly channel name to a numeric ID using case-insensitive matching with guild-qualified and prefix fallback
lookup_channel_type: lookup the channel type string for a given platform and chat ID, returning the type or None if unknown
format_directory_for_display: format the channel directory as a human-readable list grouped by platform and guild for display to the model
